title: Root Vegetable Tart
subtitle: with cream cheese on puff pastry
description: A neat puff pastry tart spread with cream cheese and topped with concentric circles of thinly sliced potato, beetroot, sweet potato, zucchini and carrot.

steps.text: Roll out the puff pastry to 3 mm thick. Mark a 20 cm circle with a knife and cut around it with a sharp knife. Mark a smaller 18 cm circle inside, pressing the mark in but not cutting through, so the rim puffs up more than the centre.

Make sure all the vegetables are dry and cold. Slice the potatoes and beetroot as thinly as possible, the sweet potato 2 to 3 mm thick, the zucchini 4 to 5 mm thick, and the carrots diagonally 3 mm thick, lightly blanched in boiling water. Brush each vegetable with olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Sprinkle a little thyme on the potato.
Spread the cream cheese over the inner circle of the pastry. Arrange the vegetables in tight circles from the outside in, in this order: potato, beetroot, sweet potato, zucchini and carrot.
Bake for about 6 minutes. Lower the temperature to 170°C and bake for another 15 minutes. If the tart browns too fast, cover with foil or baking paper, and take it out when the pastry is cooked.
